summary.headline: Astrological Elections, Chapters 32–55
summary.text: Continuation of a list of astrological elections, chapters 32–55, covering demolishing buildings, planting, children’s education and weaning, medical procedures, petitions to rulers, war, travel, marriage, hunting, farming, and markets. The prescriptions chiefly judge the Moon, ascendant, signs, angles, malefics, Mars, and planetary aspects.
